DECISION: Embed actual terminals inside Pixel Office UI using xterm.js (browser) + node-pty (server-side PTY)

OPTIONS: Status quo (dashboard only), live transcript feed, multi-agent dispatch, embedded terminals

REASONING: Ned's pain is context-switching between tools. 'One thing to rule them all' — spawn claude in node-pty, stream to xterm.js panel below the canvas, click worker to switch terminals. Existing hook/approval system works unchanged because spawned Claude Code still curls same endpoints.

STACK:
- node-pty: spawn claude processes server-side as real PTYs
- xterm.js: render terminal in browser panel below canvas
- WebSocket: stream PTY ↔ xterm.js (infra already exists)
- '+ New Worker' button spawns claude in new PTY, worker appears at desk
- Click worker → attach to their PTY stream

REVISIT WHEN: If node-pty integration proves too complex or xterm.js performance is bad on large outputs
